page.dashboard:
Everything here is calculated from real orders, payments, production and stock records, never typed in by hand.
Use the filters to look at one location or a date range. Tap the quick buttons to start common jobs.
page.dashboardSub: Live view of sales, stock and money
page.loginHelp: Forgot your password? Ask the owner to reset it.
page.myAttendance:
Check in when you start work and check out when you finish. Your pay is calculated from these records.
A day with 6 hours or more counts as a full day, 3 to 6 hours as a half day (the owner can change these hours).
Forgot to check out? Ask your manager to correct it, otherwise that day is not paid.
page.deliveryCharges:
Delivery cost is worked out automatically for every order:
1. Distance slabs: the distance from your unit to the customer's map pin decides the base fee.
2. Busy-day surcharge: once a day already has many orders, new orders pay extra.
3. Free delivery: orders above the amount set in Settings pay nothing.
Addresses without a map pin use the default fee from Settings.
page.settings: These settings apply to the whole business. Change GST, invoice and delivery rules only after confirming with your accountant. Brand colours update instantly for everyone after saving.
page.settingsSub: Business, GST, invoice, delivery and payroll rules
page.orders:
An order moves through: Pending → Confirmed (stock is reserved) → Dispatched (stock is deducted and the invoice is created) → Delivered.
A delivery address is required: add one with a map pin so the delivery charge is exact.
Pending orders can be edited. After confirming, only the instructions can change; cancel and re-create if the items are wrong.
page.invoices: Invoices are created automatically when an order is dispatched and cannot be edited. Use Record payment for cash, UPI or bank money; part payments are fine. Print opens a bill you can print or save as PDF.
page.cashClosing: At the end of the day count the cash in the drawer and enter it. The system compares it with the cash it expects (cash received minus refunds; change given back is not counted). A day can be closed only once.
page.subscriptions: A subscription creates an order automatically on the chosen weekdays. Holidays are skipped and the same day is never ordered twice. Pause when the customer is away; Renew extends the end date.
page.holidays: Subscription orders are skipped on these dates.
page.customers: Households and hotels are both customers. The price group decides which price list is used; the discount % is applied on top. Add the first address here, with a map pin, so orders can be delivered.
page.addresses: A customer can have many delivery addresses. Pin each one on the map: the pin is used to work out the delivery distance and the rider's navigation.
page.promotions: Automatic offers such as 'buy 5 get 1 free'. They apply on their own when an order qualifies.
page.coupons: Coupon codes the customer types when ordering. Each customer can use a coupon only as many times as you allow.
page.production: Choose a recipe and how many litres you made. The system deducts the raw materials by itself and adds the batter to stock with a batch number and expiry date. Then use Package to turn bulk batter into packets.
page.recipes: A recipe lists the ingredients needed for a standard amount of batter (for example 100 litres). Production scales it up or down automatically.
page.stock: Current stock at each location: raw materials, bulk batter and packets. You cannot type stock numbers directly. Use Adjust for wastage or corrections (a reason is required) and Transfer to move stock to another location.
page.ledger: Every stock change is recorded here and can never be edited or deleted. The balance of any item equals the sum of its movements, so you can always trace where stock went.
page.rawMaterials: Ingredients and packaging items (rice, urad dal, carry bags...). Set a minimum stock and you get an alert when it runs low.
page.suppliers: People you buy raw materials from.
page.purchases: Record what you bought. A purchase is a draft until you press Receive stock, which adds it to inventory (only once). Drafts can be edited or deleted; received purchases are locked. Use Record payment for what you paid the supplier.
page.units: Units of measure (litre, kg, gram...). Each unit says how many base units it contains, so the system can convert correctly. You rarely need to change these.
page.products: What you sell (idli batter, dosa batter). Choose whether it is measured in litres or kg. Set the GST rate and HSN code only after confirming with your accountant.
page.packages: Pack sizes you sell (500 ml, 1 litre, 2 litres...). Add any custom size you need.
page.prices: Selling price of each pack for each price group, valid from a date. To change a price, add a new price with a new start date: old orders keep the price they were sold at.
page.delivery: Assign dispatched orders to a delivery employee. Employees see only their own deliveries, mark them delivered or failed, and can collect cash or UPI. Start duty to share location while the app is open (needs the employee's consent).
page.slabs: Set the base fee for each distance band from your unit. Fee = base fee + extra per km beyond the start of the band. Bands for the same location must not overlap. Leave 'Up to' empty for 'and beyond'.
page.surge: When a day already has this many orders at a location, new orders for that day pay extra: either a percent of the delivery fee or a flat amount.
page.attendance: All check-ins from your team. Use this page only to fix mistakes (for example a missing check-out) or add a missed day: a reason is always required and the change is saved in the audit log.
page.employees: Employee details and pay rate. Salary figures are visible only to people allowed to see payroll. Create the user login first (People → Users), then add the employee profile here.
page.payroll: Pick a month to see what each employee has earned from attendance. Advances and deductions are subtracted, bonuses are added. Press Generate to create the salary entries (once per employee per month). A wrong entry is voided with a reason, never deleted.
page.users: Login accounts for your team. Give each person their own account; never share passwords. After creating a user, give them a role at a location on the Access page.
page.access: A person can do only what their role allows, and only at the locations you give them. Example: a Production Manager at Sivakasi cannot see another location.
page.expenses: Record everyday costs (fuel, electricity, rent...). Raw material bought from suppliers goes under Purchases instead, so it is not counted twice. Wrong entries are voided, not deleted.
page.locations: Your production units. Pin each on the map: the pin is where delivery distances are measured from.
page.audit: A permanent record of who changed what, and when. It cannot be edited.

dash.salesPeriod: Invoices issued in the chosen dates.
dash.cashCollected: Money actually received (cash, UPI, bank) minus refunds.
dash.receivables: Billed but not yet paid by customers.
dash.pending: Pending and confirmed orders not yet dispatched.
dash.bulk: Batter in bulk, not yet packed.
dash.expenses: Expenses + raw material purchases + salaries in the period.

order.feeWaiting: Choose the customer, location and delivery address to see the delivery charge.
order.feeDistance: About {{km}} km from your unit: base fee {{base}}
order.feeSurge: Busy-day surcharge {{amount}} ({{rule}}, order no. {{n}} of the day)
order.feeNoPin: This address has no map pin, so the default fee {{base}} is used. Add a pin for an exact charge.
order.feeNoSlab: No distance slab covers this distance, so the default fee is used.
order.feeFree: Free delivery because the order is above {{amount}}.

batch.waiting: Choose a recipe and quantity to see the raw materials this batch will use.
batch.uses: This batch of {{qty}} L will use:

confirm.orderConfirm: Confirm this order? Stock will be reserved for it.
confirm.orderDispatch: Dispatch this order? Stock is deducted and the invoice is created.
confirm.subCancel: Cancel this subscription? No more orders will be created.

settings.shelfLife: How many days batter stays sellable after production. Used to set each batch's expiry date.
settings.loyalty: Points a customer earns for every ₹100 spent on a completed order.
settings.scheme: Regular: GST is charged and a Tax Invoice is printed. Composition or unregistered: no GST is charged and a Bill of Supply is printed. Ask your accountant which applies.
settings.prefix: Letters at the start of every invoice number, e.g. ZE/26-27/00001.
settings.upi: Your UPI ID (like name@bank). Unpaid invoices then show a scan-to-pay QR code.
settings.bank: Printed on invoices so customers can pay by bank transfer.
settings.footer: A short thank-you or terms line at the bottom of the bill.
settings.delivery: Used when the system works out delivery charges. Distance slabs and busy-day rules are on the Delivery charges page.
settings.defaultFee: Charged when an address has no map pin or no slab covers its distance.
settings.freeAbove: Orders at or above this amount get free delivery. Enter 0 to switch it off.
settings.maxKm: Orders beyond this distance are refused. Enter 0 for no limit.
settings.roadFactor: Roads are longer than a straight line. The straight distance is multiplied by this number (1.3 is typical).
settings.attendance: These rules turn check-in hours into paid days.
settings.workingDays: A monthly salary is divided by this number to get one day's pay.
settings.fullDay: Worked at least this many hours = 1 paid day.
settings.halfDay: Worked at least this many (but less than a full day) = half a day.

field.reason: Say why. This is saved in the audit log.
field.orderCustomer: Search by name or phone. Add new customers on the Customers page.
field.orderLines: Add each pack size and how many packets. Prices come from the price list for this customer's price group.
field.orderAddress: Required. Choose the delivery address or add a new one with a map pin.
field.scheduled: The day it should be delivered. Leave empty for today.
field.coupon: Optional. Type the customer's coupon code.
field.instructions: For the delivery person, e.g. 'call at the gate'.
field.payAmount: The amount that goes against the bill. It cannot be more than what is due.
field.tender: Cash only. If the customer handed over more than the bill, enter it here and the change is worked out. Example: bill ₹250, given ₹500, change ₹250.
field.reference: Required for UPI and bank: the transaction or UTR number.
field.countedCash: Count the notes and coins in the drawer and enter the total.
field.subEnd: Leave empty to use the plan length (week, month or year).
field.planDays: Orders are created on the selected days only.
field.phone: 10-digit mobile number. Used to find the customer quickly.
field.priceGroup: Which price list this customer buys at. Hotels usually get Hotel or Bulk prices.
field.discount: Extra discount on every order of this customer, on top of the price list. Leave 0 for none.
field.customerGstin: For hotels with GST: it is printed on their invoices.
field.firstAddress: Delivery address. You can add more later on the Addresses page.
field.pin: Pin the exact spot. It sets the delivery distance, the charge and the rider's navigation.
field.addressLabel: A short name such as Home, Shop or Hotel kitchen.
field.promoPackage: Leave empty to apply the offer to every pack size.
field.buyFree: Example: buy 5, get 1 free. The free packets are added automatically.
field.couponCode: What the customer types, e.g. PONGAL10. Not case sensitive.
field.perCustomer: How many times one customer may use this coupon.
field.batchRecipe: The recipe decides which raw materials are used.
field.batchQty: Total litres of batter made. Raw materials are deducted in proportion.
field.qualityPassed: Untick if the batch failed your quality check. Failed batches cannot be packed or sold.
field.batchNotes: Only notes can change after production. To correct quantities use a stock adjustment.
field.packBatch: Only pack sizes of this batch's product are shown.
field.units: How many packets. The matching litres are taken from this batch's bulk stock.
field.recipeOutput: The amount of batter these ingredients make, e.g. 100 litres.
field.recipeLines: List each ingredient, its quantity and unit for that amount.
field.delta: Use a minus sign to reduce stock, e.g. -5. Wastage, expiry and damage must be negative.
field.toLocation: The stock leaves here and arrives there in one step.
field.nameTa: Optional Tamil name shown to Tamil-language users.
field.rawUnit: The unit you buy and count it in.
field.minStock: You get a low-stock alert below this amount.
field.packagingMaterial: Tick for carry bags, pouches and labels.
field.supplierInvoice: The supplier's bill number, for your records.
field.purchaseLines: Each item bought, the quantity and the price per unit.
field.unitFactor: How many base units it holds: ml/g are 1, litre/kg are 1000.
field.baseUnit: Litre or kg: the unit bulk batter is measured in.
field.density: Only if you sell by both litre and kg: kg in one litre (about 1.05 for idli batter).
field.hsn: Tax classification code. Confirm with your accountant.
field.gst: GST rate for this product. Confirm with your accountant.
field.packageUnit: Packs of a product measured in litres should use ml or litre.
field.priceAmount: Selling price per packet (includes GST if Settings says so).
field.effectiveFrom: The price applies from this date. Old orders keep their old price.
field.assignOrder: Only dispatched orders can be assigned.
field.stop: The order of stops on the route: 1 is first.
field.proof: Optional: who received it, or any note.
field.slabLabel: A name for this band, e.g. Nearby, Town, Outskirts.
field.slabMin: Where this band starts, in km from your unit.
field.slabMax: Where it ends. Leave empty for the last band ('and beyond').
field.slabBase: The delivery fee for a customer inside this band.
field.slabPerKm: Optional extra for each km beyond the start of the band.
field.surgeMin: Applies when the day has at least this many orders, counting the new one.
field.surgeType: Percent of the delivery fee, or a flat rupee amount.
field.surgeValue: The percent (e.g. 20) or the rupees to add.
field.checkOut: Leave empty if the person is still working.
field.attendanceReason: Why the record is being added or changed. Saved in the audit log.
field.empUser: The login account of this employee (create it first on the Users page).
field.salaryType: Monthly salary is paid by days present; hourly is paid by hours worked.
field.salary: Full monthly salary. It is reduced for days not worked.
field.hourly: Pay for each hour worked (hourly employees only).
field.payType: Advance and deduction are subtracted from pay, bonus is added. Salary entries are generated from attendance.
field.payPeriod: Any date in the month this belongs to.
field.username: Used to log in. Cannot be changed later.
field.password: At least 8 characters, not too common. Leave empty on edit to keep the current one.
field.role: What this person may do at the location. Hover the role names in the docs for details.
field.expenseCategory: Raw materials bought from suppliers belong under Purchases.
field.locCode: 2-4 letters, used in batch numbers (e.g. SVK).
field.locPin: Pin your unit. Delivery distances are measured from here.
